ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var queryParams = attributes.queryParams var headers = attributes.headers var mqUrl = if(isEmpty(vars.amqConfig.mqUrl)) Mule::p('anypointMQ.url') replace "{region}" with headers.region replace "{orgId}" with headers.orgId replace "{envId}" with headers.envId else "" var queueName = payload.transaction match { case "RTO" -> payload.sourceQueue case "TMQ" -> payload.targetQueue else -> "" } --- { "orgId": headers.orgId, "envId": headers.envId, "mqUrl": mqUrl, "transaction": payload.transaction, "amqClientId": vars.resolvedAmqClientId, "amqClientSecret": vars.resolvedAmqClientSecret, "queueName": queueName, "sourceQueue": payload.sourceQueue, "targetQueue": payload.targetQueue }

%dw 2.0 output application/java var queryParams = attributes.queryParams var headers = attributes.headers var allMessages = payload.allMessages default false --- { "orgId": headers.orgId, "envId": headers.envId, "queueName": payload.sourceQueue, "allMessages": allMessages, "messageIdList": if(!allMessages) payload.messageIdList else null }

anypoint-mq:publish.anypoint-mq:body: #[%dw 2.0 var baseCt = trim(((payload.contentType default "application/json") splitBy ";")[0]) var ct = if(baseCt == "text/csv") "application/csv" else baseCt output application/java --- if(payload.data is String) payload.data else write(payload.data default "", ct)]

#[%dw 2.0 var baseCt = trim(((payload.contentType default "application/json") splitBy ";")[0]) var ct = if(baseCt == "text/csv") "application/csv" else baseCt output application/java --- if(payload.data is String) payload.data else write(payload.data default "", ct)]

ee:transform.doc:name: Message Id or returnAllMessages is mandatory

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Queue not available. The target queue does not exist in this region/org/environment.", "error": error.description default "DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND" }
